body: From the DM-265 review (orchestrator, this run): getMetricsSummary runs synchronously in the main process and is superlinear in runs (fix in progress in DM-265). Load the dashboard once on open and on manual refresh, never on polling; omit `until` for live reads; do not label totals as 'in window' (`since` filters rows and trend entries only); a trend entry's `comparable` does not imply it has a delta.
